import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Preprocess features
X = train.drop(["Id", "Cover_Type"], axis=1)
y = train["Cover_Type"]
train_id = train["Id"]

X_test_raw = test.drop("Id", axis=1)
test_id = test["Id"]

# Ensure test features align with training columns
X_test = X_test_raw[X.columns]

# Robust scaling for outlier resistance
scaler = RobustScaler()
X_scaled = pd.DataFrame(scaler.fit_transform(X), columns=X.columns)
X_test_scaled = pd.DataFrame(scaler.transform(X_test), columns=X.columns)

# Create enhanced interaction features for key terrain variables
X_scaled["Elev_Aspect"] = X_scaled["Elevation"] * np.cos(
    X_scaled["Aspect"] * np.pi / 180
)
X_scaled["Elev_Slope"] = X_scaled["Elevation"] * X_scaled["Slope"]
X_scaled["Elev_DistHydro1"] = X_scaled["Elevation"] / (
    X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)
X_scaled["Elev_DistRoad"] = X_scaled["Elevation"] / (
    X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)
X_scaled["Vert_DistHydro1"] = X_scaled["Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology"] / (
    X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)
X_scaled["Slope_DistRoad"] = X_scaled["Slope"] / (
    X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)
X_scaled["DistFire_Road"] = X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"] / (
    X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)

X_test_scaled["Elev_Aspect"] = X_test_scaled["Elevation"] * np.cos(
    X_test_scaled["Aspect"] * np.pi / 180
)
X_test_scaled["Elev_Slope"] = X_test_scaled["Elevation"] * X_test_scaled["Slope"]
X_test_scaled["Elev_DistHydro1"] = X_test_scaled["Elevation"] / (
    X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)
X_test_scaled["Elev_DistRoad"] = X_test_scaled["Elevation"] / (
    X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)
X_test_scaled["Vert_DistHydro1"] = X_test_scaled["Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology"] / (
    X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)
X_test_scaled["Slope_DistRoad"] = X_test_scaled["Slope"] / (
    X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)
X_test_scaled["DistFire_Road"] = X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"] / (
    X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)

for i in range(1, 5):
    X_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Elev"] = X_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * X_scaled["Elevation"]
    X_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Slope"] = X_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * X_scaled["Slope"]
    X_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Hydro"] = X_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * (
        1000 / (X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1)
    )
    X_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Road"] = X_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * (
        1000 / (X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1)
    )

for i in range(1, 5):
    X_test_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Elev"] = (
        X_test_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * X_test_scaled["Elevation"]
    )
    X_test_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Slope"] = (
        X_test_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * X_test_scaled["Slope"]
    )
    X_test_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Hydro"] = X_test_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * (
        1000 / (X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1)
    )
    X_test_scaled[f"Wild_{i}_Road"] = X_test_scaled[f"Wilderness_Area{i}"] * (
        1000 / (X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1)
    )

X_scaled["Hillshade_Slope"] = X_scaled["Hillshade_9am"] * X_scaled["Slope"]
X_scaled["Hillshade_Road"] = X_scaled["Hillshade_9am"] / (
    X_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)

X_test_scaled["Hillshade_Slope"] = (
    X_test_scaled["Hillshade_9am"] * X_test_scaled["Slope"]
)
X_test_scaled["Hillshade_Road"] = X_test_scaled["Hillshade_9am"] / (
    X_test_scaled["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] + 1
)

print(f"Class distribution: {y.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()}")
print(f"Total features after engineering: {len(X_scaled.columns)}")

# Hold-out validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_scaled, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

# Initialize model with tuned hyperparameters
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    max_depth=8,
    min_child_samples=10,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.5,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=4,
    force_row_wise=True,
    random_state=42,
)

# Train on training split only
print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate on held-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy}")

# Generate submission predictions
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test_scaled)

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_id, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred.astype(int)})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission contains {len(submission)} rows")
print(f"Validation metric (accuracy): {val_accuracy}")
